flipToBack.prose: Flip if Luke can be spotted as a captive (anywhere; spot includes captives and battle-excluded cards). The capture itself is engineered by a separate front trigger: when any Imperial that can escort is at Luke's site, Luke is captured and seized (required trigger).

children.req: chosen-state spot: Luke is a captive (captured-state condition, not location-based)

citations: src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set9/light/Card9_061.java:124-148 (auto-capture trigger that produces the flip state)

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if Luke can NOT be spotted as (captive OR present with Vader). I.e., flips back when Luke is free and away from Vader; also flips back if Luke is no longer on table at all (spot fails entirely).

children.req: chosen-state spot: Luke either captive or present-with Vader (presence semantics via Filters.presentWith)
children.gameConditions: GameConditions.canSpot(game, self, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_CAPTIVE_AND_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.Luke, Filters.or(Filters.captive, Filters.presentWith(self, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.Vader))))

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: chosen-state (captured-state) semantics via canSpot with INCLUDE_CAPTIVE_AND_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE. No control, occupy, or location requirement at all.

Capture engine (front): timing trigger on isTableChanged; Filters.findFirstActive(Luke at site) then canSpot Imperial with Filters.atSameSite(luke) AND Filters.canEscortCaptive(luke, true); opponent chooses the seizing Imperial; CaptureWithSeizureEffect. This is the mechanism that creates the flip state.
flipToFront: negated chosen-state/presence disjunction: Luke captive OR Luke presentWith Vader; if neither spotable (including Luke gone from table), back flips to front.
Back Force-loss clock: timing trigger isEndOfOpponentsTurn + NOT canSpot(Filters.and(Filters.Vader, Filters.escorting(Filters.Luke))): opponent loses 2 Force. Escort-state semantics.
Back crossover: once per owner's turn, requires Vader presentWith Luke (SpotOverride.INCLUDE_CAPTIVE), i.e. presence-with semantics including captive Luke.
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Icon.DEATH_STAR_II, Filters.Luke) ([Death Star II] Luke setup deploy)
Filters.or(Filters.Alter, Filters.Strangle, Filters.Captive_Fury) (owner's remainder-of-game play ban)
Filters.sameSiteAs(self, Filters.Luke) / Filters.sameLocationAs(self, Filters.Luke) (Force gen +2; drain/generation locks)
Filters.Imperial at Filters.Landing_Platform (AtCondition gating the locks)
Back: Filters.escorting(Filters.Luke), Filters.escortedBy(self, Filters.and(Filters.Imperial, Filters.except(Filters.Vader))), Filters.canEscortCaptive(captiveLuke)
setupAndPullRoutes: START OF GAME (front, all required): deploy Chief Chirpa's Hut (Filters.Chief_Chirpas_Hut) [Card9_061.java:56-62]; deploy [Death Star II] Luke to Chief Chirpa's Hut (Filters.and(Icon.DEATH_STAR_II, Filters.Luke) -> Filters.Chief_Chirpas_Hut) [Card9_061.java:63-69]; deploy Luke's Lightsaber to Chief Chirpa's Hut (Filters.Lukes_Lightsaber) [Card9_061.java:70-76]; deploy Endor: Landing Platform (Filters.Landing_Platform) [Card9_061.java:77-83]; deploy I Feel The Conflict (Filters.I_Feel_The_Conflict) [Card9_061.java:84-90]
No mid-game Reserve Deck pulls on either side (back's once-per-turn action shuffles Reserve Deck and draws destiny but takes nothing from it).
otherObligations: FRONT (after deployment, remainder of game): owner may not play Alter, Strangle, or Captive Fury: AddUntilEndOfGameModifierEffect(MayNotPlayModifier(self, Filters.or(Filters.Alter, Filters.Strangle, Filters.Captive_Fury), playerId)) [Card9_061.java:95-101]
FRONT: owner's Force generation +2 at Luke's site: ForceGenerationModifier(self, Filters.sameSiteAs(self, Filters.Luke), 2, playerId) [Card9_061.java:110]

FRONT: while an Imperial at Landing Platform, owner may not Force drain at Luke's location: MayNotForceDrainAtLocationModifier(self, sameLocationAs(Luke), AtCondition(Imperial, Landing_Platform), playerId) [Card9_061.java:111]
FRONT: while an Imperial at Landing Platform, owner generates no Force at Luke's location: GenerateNoForceModifier [Card9_061.java:112]
FRONT auto-capture trap: on table change, if Luke at a site and a capture-capable Imperial is at same site, Luke is captured with seizure; opponent picks the escort [Card9_061.java:124-148]

BACK: at end of each opponent's turn, opponent loses 2 Force unless Vader is escorting Luke: isEndOfOpponentsTurn + !canSpot(Vader escorting Luke) -> LoseForceEffect(opponent, 2) [Card9_061_BACK.java:60-68]
BACK (opponent action): an Imperial (except Vader) escorting Luke may transfer Luke to Vader if Vader presentWith and can escort [Card9_061_BACK.java:90-113]
BACK: Luke may not be transferred while escorted by Vader: MayNotBeTransferredModifier(self, Filters.and(Filters.Luke, Filters.escortedBy(self, Filters.Vader))) [Card9_061_BACK.java:169]

BACK win route: once per owner's turn, if Vader presentWith Luke (INCLUDE_CAPTIVE), shuffle Reserve Deck, draw destiny; if getCrossoverAttemptTotal(vader, totalDestiny) > 14: CrossOverCharacterEffect(vader) + DepleteLifeForceEffect(opponent) (owner wins) [Card9_061_BACK.java:116-164]
seedMismatches: Seed labels the back-side crossover route 'hardLose' with condition CROSSOVER_DESTINY_GT_14; in source it is a WIN condition for the objective owner (Vader crosses to Light Side and OPPONENT's Life Force is depleted), a TopLevelGameTextAction the owner chooses, not a loss or a required trigger. Category error in the seed.

Seed does not record that the crossover destiny total is modifier-adjusted via modifiersQuerying.getCrossoverAttemptTotal(vader, totalDestiny) before the > 14 comparison (Card9_061_BACK.java:145-147).

profileGaps: keyCharacterFilter is null: flip law's subject is Filters.Luke (and Filters.Vader drives back-side value); neither is represented.
Flip law is a captured-state condition (Luke captive), not a location condition; no profile field encodes it. flipGateSite null and flipGateCardIds empty are inherently unable to express this law.
requiredCardsOnTable empty: Luke on table (and later captive/with Vader) is the state the whole objective revolves around; not encoded.

pullableCards empty: five required start-of-game deploys (Chief Chirpa's Hut, [DSII] Luke, Luke's Lightsaber, Endor: Landing Platform, I Feel The Conflict) are not listed as pullable/required cards; only the two locations appear as objectiveNamedLocations.
The Imperial-at-Landing-Platform drain/generation lock and the auto-capture trap at Luke's site (the actual flip mechanism) have no representation.
Back-side obligations (opponent loses 2 Force per turn unless Vader escorts Luke; transfer-to-Vader route; destiny>14 crossover win) have no representation.
